  - bioconda::ccnv=1.1.0

process CCNV_EXTRACT {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/cd/cd552e195217d37801cf86348dbe875fa66ae2014147e481fd6be6e80dbbcd90/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/ccnv:1.1.0--726d8b142feb0e3d'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(reads), path(reads_index)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta), path(fai)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.ccnv"), emit: ccnv
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('ccnv'), eval("ccnv --version 2>&1 | sed 's/ccnv //'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_ccnv

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def fasta_arg = fasta ? "--fasta $fasta" : ""

    if (!reads_index) {
        error "CCNV_EXTRACT: Missing reads index file"
    }
    """
    ccnv extract\\
        --prefix ${prefix} \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        $fasta_arg \\
        $args \\
        $reads
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    echo $args

    touch ${prefix}.ccnv
    """
}

name: "nf-core/ccnv/extract"
description: "Extract read count and fragment length information from BAM/CRAM files\
  \ using CCNV"
keywords:
- "ccnv"
- "cnv"
- "nips"
- "fragmentomics"
- "genomics"
tools:
- ccnv:
    description: "CCNV is a tool to extract copy number variation information from\
      \ sequencing data."
    homepage: "https://matthdsm.github.io/ccnv/"
    documentation: "https://matthdsm.github.io/ccnv/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/matthdsm/ccnv"
    doi: ""
    licence:
    - "AGPL-3.0"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - reads:
      type: "file"
      description: "Sorted BAM/CRAM file"
      pattern: "*.{bam,cram}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2573"
  - reads_index:
      type: "file"
      description: "Index file for the reads (BAM/CRAM)"
      pattern: "*.{bai,crai,csi}"
      ontologies: []
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. `[ id:'reference1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference genome FASTA file"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fna}"
      ontologies: []
  - fai:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTA index file"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,fna}.fai"
      ontologies: []
output:
  ccnv:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.ccnv':
        type: "file"
        description: "CCNV output file"
        pattern: "*.ccnv"
        ontologies: []
  versions_ccnv:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - ccnv:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - ccnv --version 2>&1 | sed 's/ccnv //':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
